title: Perfect $2$-codes over arbitrary alphabets
summary: The classification of perfect $e$-codes over an arbitrary alphabet of size $q$ is complete for $e > 2$. In the case of non prime power $q$, it is conjectured that no perfect $2$-codes exist. We confirm this conjecture in a number of situations, including the case where $q=2^αp^β$ with $p$ prime, $α$ and $β$ positive integers, and either $α\leq 20$, or $α$ sufficiently large.
